# Decomposing three-month credit risk

This visual story uses public Bondora loans from Estonia to follow three-month forward default risk from a small vintage table through a sequential age-cohort-period decomposition, then scales the same calculation up to portfolio RD3M.

The calculations are prepared and checked in R before rendering. The browser only presents the precomputed cells, effects and portfolio reconstruction.
